summary_en: This Phase 2 study compares ramucirumab with paclitaxel against the FOLFIRI chemotherapy regimen in adults with advanced or refractory small intestinal adenocarcinoma. Ramucirumab and paclitaxel are given by vein (IV): ramucirumab on days 1 and 15 of each 28-day cycle, and paclitaxel on days 1, 8 and 15. FOLFIRI is also given by IV in 28-day cycles, and cycles repeat without disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. The record does not state the main outcome measured; it is a Phase 2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 compara ramucirumab con paclitaxel contra el régimen de quimioterapia FOLFIRI en adultos con adenocarcinoma de intestino delgado avanzado o refractario. Ramucirumab y paclitaxel se administran por vena (IV): ramucirumab los días 1 y 15 de cada ciclo de 28 días, y paclitaxel los días 1, 8 y 15. FOLFIRI también se administra por IV en ciclos de 28 días, y los ciclos se repiten mientras no haya progresión de la enfermedad ni toxicidad inaceptable. El registro no indica el resultado principal que se mide; es un estudio de fase 2.
who_for: Small bowel adenocarcinoma confirmed by tissue or cell testing
Metastatic or locally advanced disease that cannot be removed by surgery
Disease that progressed on prior fluoropyrimidine and/or oxaliplatin therapy
not_for: Prior irinotecan, taxane, or ramucirumab for small bowel adenocarcinoma
Tumors with deficient mismatch repair (dMMR) or microsatellite instability high (MSI-H)
Recent arterial or venous blood clot, or recent grade 3-4 GI bleeding
History of GI perforation or fistula within 120 days
Chronic antiplatelet therapy or uncontrolled high blood pressure
